## What changed

- Your project's own files no longer cause conflicts when you upgrade to a newer template (#68)
- Verify now runs as a single step, and CI fails when a summary falls behind (#72)

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.17.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.17.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.16.1...v0.17.0
